label: SIMULATED (real discord.js UserManager, REST, REST route queue and VOICE_STATE_UPDATE handler; real @discordjs/voice receiver; only the REST wire (makeRequest), the voice network edge and the native davey session are fakes). Not live Discord.
beforeMethod: b13185f's packages/discord-bridge/src extracted with git archive; production code verbatim. Added only the new harness files (src/testing/controlled-rest.ts, src/testing/fake-voice.ts), the test file, and a stub src/core/identity-requests.ts exporting an empty IdentityRequests class (the harness passes it; b13185f ignores the option).

R1-A.scenario: A human speaks in the source channel; their REST identity request is on the wire; they leave (VOICE_STATE_UPDATE channel_id null); the request answers bot:false; their packets keep arriving for 300 ms.

R1-B.scenario: A human speaks; their REST identity request is unsettled; they leave and rejoin while still speaking.

R1-C.scenario: Three DiscordBot instances created one after another in one process (each destroyed before the next), each with the production default identity registry and 10 new unknown speakers; every REST request stalls.
